new_assertions.body: The turn-restricted final-cap rule C is a non-hereditary slice of a stronger direct rank-local rule G based on the fixed final-board mover.
A non-final-player residual containing every current open top cap is permanently dead because completing all those caps fills the board and the final cap is owned by the other player.
On complete 4x4, replacing C with hereditary G removes the previous Q-F/Q-A gap and yields a smaller exact Q-F representation.
The smallest tested transporter-aware complete-4x4 Q-F/Q-A/Q-V representation is now q_SigmaRFG with 9,308 classes.
G and RFG survive complete odd-cell and even-cell controls, so the rule is not an artifact of the 4x4 final-player parity convention.

add_fixed: q_SigmaRFG has 9,308 exact transporter-aware Q-F classes on complete 4x4
G/RFG proof obligations pass complete 3x3-k3, 3x4-k3, 4x3-k3 and 4x4-k4 controls
the prior observed Q-A/Q-V advantage from C was eliminated by strengthening C to the hereditary current-rank rule G
retain_open: whether Q-A/Q-V can still be strictly smaller than the new q_SigmaRFG using other rank-local rules
